cleanup.limitation: All resources from the connectivity preflight, three single-worker smoke attempts, a two-worker cycle, a ready-worker restart, two accepted-creation attempts, an accepted-removal cycle and a lost-expansion-response cycle were confirmed absent twice per isolated attempt. All six Spot instances across released-job preparation and job attempts were also deleted; every fixture was confirmed absent twice. The temporary prepared image and its one snapshot were deleted. Both successful jobs passed normal release before fallback cleanup. The pre-release gate separately verified zero leftovers in all six receipts and a workflow-completion janitor with no fixtures to recover. Scheduled abandoned-fixture recovery and broader lifecycle recovery remain unverified.
